Example Engineering Girls Scholarship

The Example Foundation helps school students who want to become engineers.

Eligibility

The scholarship is open to girls studying in Class 12 at a recognised school anywhere in India.

It is meant for those who plan to pursue engineering after school.

Applicants must rank in the top 1% of their board.

Benefits

Selected students receive full tuition for four years of their degree.

How to apply

Fill in the online form on this page and upload your mark sheet before the window shuts.
